title: finding(fields,a11y,i18n): `ImageField` names a nameless image with the untranslated literal 'Image', so its alt text and enlarge label never reach the translated `fields.image.imageAlt`
body: Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named landing site and a reproduction. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the execution seat that claims it. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 5 (`session_01KUxVUa7e39aNjhkKi1gsoy`) from the objectui#10493 dev report (PR objectui#10575). The dev reported it as class a, and the seat re-read it at source on objectui `origin/main` `e0f8202`. ⛔ Filed bare, not graded here. ## The defect `packages/fields/src/widgets/ImageField.tsx:84` builds its views with `readFileValues(value, 'Image')`. `readFileValues` (`packages/fields/src/widgets/file-value.ts:174`) puts that `fallbackName` on every value that carries no name of its own. So `img.name` is the English literal `'Image'`, a truthy string, for a nameless image. The widget's translated fallback then never runs: - `alt={img.name || t('fields.image.imageAlt', { index: idx + 1 })}` at `:159`; - the enlarge button's `aria-label={t('fields.image.enlarge', { name: img.name || t('fields.image.imageAlt', …) })}` at `:155`. A screen reader under `zh` (or any non-en locale) therefore reads `Image` for every nameless image, and the enlarge label embeds the same English word. The lightbox gets the same name. **Reproduction** (the dev's probe): under `zh`, a bare-id image value ⇒ the `` alt is `'Image'`, not the translated `fields.image.imageAlt`. **Lit control** on the same tree: the image CELL renderer (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx:2292-2293`) computes `name || t('fields.image.imageAlt', { index: idx + 1 })` from the value's OWN name. Its docblock at `:2257` says the literal `'Image'` was retired there by objectui#10493. ## Dedupe Searched this repo with the MCP semantic issue search, including closed issues: - `ImageField alt text untranslated literal 'Image' imageAlt fallback never reached` ⇒ objectui#10493 (closed): the origin card, which fixed the `data:` URI alt and the cell, not this widget's fallback name. The hit shows the instrument is lit. Dedupe words: `ImageField Image alt untranslated` · `imageAlt unreachable ImageField` · `readFileValues Image fallback` · `enlarge label Image literal`
